result.title: Sketch, Don't Paint: Allocating Test-Time Compute in Generative Visual Reasoning
result.summary: Multimodal models increasingly reason by synthesizing pixels, sketching maze paths within interleaved chains of thought or rolling out video solutions frame by frame. Each visual thought runs the full diffusion schedule inherited from photorealistic synthesis, so iterative denoising dominates inference cost. We study how to allocate test-time compute along two axes: when to render visual thoughts rather than thinking in text or answering directly, and how many denoising steps each thought requires. Controlled interventions that vary only how the thought is rendered uncover three regimes. Causal thoughts carry the plan and become legible early: an 8-step sketch nearly matches a 50-step render in accuracy, commits to the same plan as often as two independent full renders agree, and in video models mostly fails by stalling short of the goal, so the rollout abstains. Decorative thoughts can be omitted without loss, whereas harmful thoughts lower accuracy. Because the regime depends on both model and task, always drawing is suboptimal. Across 14 model-benchmark pairs of three interleaved reasoners, answering directly, without any thinking, wins 9 pairs, and choosing among direct, text-only, and visual tiers from ten labeled examples per pair raises mean accuracy from 60.7% (always drawing) to 65.1%. Where drawing pays, we propose sketch-and-vote, which samples 8-step sketches (a step count chosen without labels) from independent noises until one answer reaches three votes. With this one setting, sketch-and-vote beats full rendering with fewer denoising steps on an image reasoner and two video reasoners, by 8.6 points on VSP spatial planning and by 9.6 and 22.1 points on mazes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究生成式视觉推理的测试时计算分配：通过控制实验比较「直接回答／纯文本思考／渲染视觉思考」三种模式，以及每条视觉思考所需的去噪步数，发现因果性视觉思维在约8步时已可读出与原计划一致的信息，装饰性思维可省略、有害思维反而降分；并提出 sketch-and-vote，用少步草图多次独立采样并投票选答。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应 THINK／LOOK／STOP 的收益与成本核算和停止决策，其「何时渲染视觉证据」「少步渲染是否已保留任务必要信息」及草图投票的答案聚合方式，可供核查 latent 视觉状态的保真度、冗余与动态计算价值。
